name: DPP Manufacturer
description: Verifies supplier passports, publishes its own UNTP Digital Product Passport and one Make record per supplier product.
summary: Manufacturer wallet for workflows/dpp-workflow.md on the NOOP trust framework. It issues and publishes the UNTP DigitalProductPassport for its product (product_passport, "dpp" link) and a DigitalTraceabilityEvent Make record per supplier product (make_event, "dte" link), both jwt_vc_vcdm signed with its did:web and a numeric status list index. Its dcc_disclosure verifier requests a supplier's unpublished Digital Conformity Credential over WMP. Created with issuers, so it gets the did:web it publishes under.
